title: Orphaned VBA Projects Inside DWG Files: YARA Rule, (Sun, Oct 18th)
description: A YARA rule has been published to detect orphaned VBA projects inside DWG files. The rule identifies specific signatures related to these orphaned VBA projects. A VirusTotal retrohunt using this rule found only two detections, indicating limited prevalence. No specific vulnerability or exploit details are provided.
aiSummary: The provided YARA rule targets orphaned VBA projects embedded within DWG files by matching specific byte patterns and strings such as 'AC10', a magic header, and '[Host Extender Info]'. This detection method aims to identify potentially suspicious or leftover VBA code within AutoCAD drawing files. The retrohunt results suggest these occurrences are rare, with only two detections found on VirusTotal. No further technical details or exploitation information are included.
aiImpact: No direct impact or exploitation details are described. The detection of orphaned VBA projects may indicate leftover or potentially malicious VBA code within DWG files, but no active threats or vulnerabilities are confirmed.
